dependency.role: Only package dependency in Ur Package.swift; tutor seam, not rendering backend

finding: Ur does not provide a reusable Metal compute, virtual-GPU or Hypervisor/paravirtualization implementation. URRenderKit is an actual CPU Core Graphics/vImage renderer; the iOS RealityKit scene delegates rendering to Apple and exposes no Prime compute or vGPU interface.

implementedRoutes.name: URRenderKit headless board
implementedRoutes.implementation: Allocates a bitmap CGContext, invokes BoardPainter through CGTarget, and blurs with Accelerate vImageBoxConvolve_ARGB8888 CPU buffers. This is a primary CPU route, not a GPU failure fallback.

implementedRoutes.name: SwiftUI board
implementedRoutes.implementation: Shared BoardPainter through GraphicsContextTarget into SwiftUI Canvas. No repository-owned Metal shader, MTLDevice, command queue or explicit GPU completion.

implementedRoutes.name: RealityKit board
implementedRoutes.implementation: iOS-only RealityView using authored USDZ entities, virtual scene camera, lights and gestures. Non-iOS implementation is Color.black. The virtual camera is unrelated to a virtual GPU.
implementedRoutes.limits: No exported compute buffers, shader dispatch, guest device driver or host/guest GPU transport.

implementedRoutes.name: Chrome snapshots
implementedRoutes.implementation: SwiftUI ImageRenderer default; explicit --backend=hosting uses NSHostingView.cacheDisplay into NSBitmapImageRep. Alternative UI rasterization capability, not GPU virtualization.

reusableCode.use: Backend-independent semantic paint protocol; a new Metal backend could implement it, but none is present.
Pure state/size/phase to drawing commands; actual reusable scene definition.
Packed RGBA bytes for a deterministic CPU reference.
Pixel hashing and sampling for parity review.

testsAndRetainedEvidence.claim: R1 deterministic buffers, R3 fit, R4 state pixels, R5 color law, R6 clock-independent canonical phase. Present source; not run in this audit.
R2 CG versus ImageRenderer spatial-confinement assertions. Tight region max <=3/255, fewer than0.1% over2/255, soft MAE<6, whole frame MAE<1. Source assertions are not a new execution receipt.
Historical July7 commit records whole-frame MAE0.69/255 for CG versus ImageRenderer. Retained commit report; no raw numerical receipt discovered in the narrowly inspected render evidence files.
Recorded July8 stable macOS15.7.7/Xcode26.3 render success for both backends, GitHub run28924042371; beta crash classified beta-only. Local retained accounting, remote run not fetched.

negativeSearchScope.result: No repository-owned Metal compute, Hypervisor or virtual-GPU implementation found. UI text and RealityKit virtual camera were inspected rather than counted as device capability.

recommendedBoundary: Use existing Prime host-Metal/guest-feedback machinery for an actual compute-route measurement. Ur contributes a deterministic visual CPU reference and scene adapter if a future graphics experiment is wanted; adding or measuring a real virtual GPU requires additional implementation outside the found Ur code.
